rewrites.yea_description: Voted for Senate File 4, which makes state park rangers and managers peace officers and lets them act outside a park. The Senate passed the bill 21-8 and it became law as chapter 54 of the 2025 session laws.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against Senate File 4, which makes state park rangers and managers peace officers and lets them act outside a park. The Senate passed the bill 21-8 and it became law as chapter 54 of the 2025 session laws.
